in_marathi.name: Maitreyee
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Friend of all
in_marathi.long_meaning: Maitreyee हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Maitreyee is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Maitri', which means 'friend'. The suffix 'ee' signifies 'belonging to'. Thus, Maitreyee can be translated to 'belonging to friendship' or 'friend of all'.
